# swayosd

On-screen display for volume and brightness, and the commands the keys run.

`osd-volume up|down|mute|micmute` and `osd-brightness up|down` (keys, with the OSD) or `bup|bdown` (bar scroll, plain brightnessctl at 1% steps).

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`swayosd/packages`): `swayosd`, `brightnessctl`

**Linked into your home** (stow, `install.sh --link`):

- `~/.config/swayosd/colors.css`
- `~/.config/swayosd/style.css`
- `~/.config/systemd/user/swayosd.service`
- `~/.local/bin/osd-brightness`
- `~/.local/bin/osd-volume`

**Rendered from the palette** (`theme`):

- `swayosd/.config/swayosd/colors.css.tmpl` → `swayosd/.config/swayosd/colors.css`: `accent`, `bg_hover`, `bg_widget`, `border_hairline`, `fg_text`, `name`, `slug`

**User units** (enabled by `install.sh --units`): `swayosd.service`

**`reload.sh`** (run by `theme set`): restart swayosd.service, which reads its colors at startup. try-restart leaves a stopped unit alone (a bar hidden with its toggle stays hidden).
